python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

during=Image.open('.tmp/swipe_seek_during.png').convert('RGB')
post=Image.open('.tmp/swipe_seek_post.png').convert('RGB')
arr1=np.array(during)
arr2=np.array(post)
# compare bottom 120px
h=arr1.shape[0]
b1=arr1[h-120:,:,:]
b2=arr2[h-120:,:,:]
# mean absolute difference
mad=np.abs(b1.astype('int32')-b2.astype('int32')).mean()
print('bottom_120px MAD',mad)
# compare center 1/3 vertical maybe top 400? not
PY
